dashboard.label: grype-verify: SBOM Vulnerability Overview
dashboard.description: Scan history pulled from the grype-verify REST API

search.query: index=main sourcetype=grype:check | stats latest(result) AS Result, latest(total_vulns) AS Total, latest(severity.critical) AS Critical, latest(severity.high) AS High, latest(severity.medium) AS Medium, latest(mode) AS Mode, latest(_time) AS LastScan BY sbom_path | eval Component=replace(sbom_path,".*/","") | eval LastScan=strftime(LastScan,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | table Component Result Total Critical High Medium Mode LastScan | sort - Critical - High
index=main sourcetype=grype:check | timechart span=1d sum(severity.critical) AS Critical, sum(severity.high) AS High, sum(severity.medium) AS Medium

panel.title: Scans running offline (cached DB — results may be stale)

search.query: index=main sourcetype=grype:check mode=offline | eval Component=replace(sbom_path,".*/","") | eval Scanned=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | table Scanned Component Result total_vulns | sort - Scanned
index=main sourcetype=grype:check | stats count BY mode
